# Card Container

## Summary
The bounded surface a card's content sits on, and the seam where a theme is applied.

## Shape
Provides the card's ground — background, border, radius and the boundary separating one card
from the page. `@displayBoundaries` makes that boundary explicit, which lets one component
serve both a standalone isolated card and an embedded one inside a list. It is also where
theming enters: `@isThemed`, `@themeCss`, `@themeScope` and `@cssImports` scope a theme's CSS to
this subtree, so a themed card does not leak styles into its host. `@tag` sets the element and
`...attributes` lets the caller size it from outside.

## Usage
Rendered in its states by the freestyle usage page at `packages/boxel-ui/src/components/card-container/usage.gts`.

```gts
import { CardContainer } from '@cardstack/boxel-ui/components';
```
